# gpupaas_bare_metal_instances (Data Source)

List the bare-metal instances of a project, or of one workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gpupaas_bare_metal_instances" "all" {
  project = "system-catalog"
}

output "bare_metal_by_sku" {
  value = { for b in data.gpupaas_bare_metal_instances.all.items : b.name => b.sku }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) Project to list.

### Optional

- `workspace` (String) Only the entries of this workspace. Unset lists the whole project, the entries of its workspaces included.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `items` (Attributes List) The bare-metal instances, sorted by name, with a few identifying fields. Look one up by name for the rest. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))
- `names` (List of String) Names of the bare-metal instances, sorted.

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name.
- `sku` (String) The SKU (profile) it was created from.
- `status` (String) Normalized platform status, such as `running`, `success`, `in_progress`, `failed`.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace that owns it; empty for a project-scoped one.
